visibility: All observations in this file are public; no blind-holdout claim.

records.measurement: In C6D6, TFPO 19F resonance changes from−75.24 to−75.19 ppm after mixing with the1:1 phosphine/PA preparation; TFPO methylene1H changes from2.20 to2.25 ppm. The source also observes interaction withEt3B.
records.source: main PDF p10; SI PDF pp4,11–12
records.limitation: NMR shifts establish changed environments, not an elementary rate or unique interaction geometry.

records.measurement: Adding equimolar sodium ethoxide to the phosphine/PA preparation changes reported phosphine-adjacent proton signals from2.98 to3.00 ppm and0.99 to1.00 ppm inCDCl3. Preparation usesTHF before NMR dilution.
records.source: main PDF p10; SI PDF pp4,12
records.limitation: Probe experiment; a polymer chain-end stabilization free energy is not directly measured.
